subject: What the cell-shedding framework gets right about senescence research
script: From Agewell Brief: What the cell-shedding framework gets right about senescence research. Senescent cells are often called “zombie cells” because they may stop dividing while remaining metabolically active. The Cell Shedding guide turns that research idea into a program framework built around renewal, transport, and deliberate cycles. Cellular senescence is a real area of aging biology. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
